name: walkthrough
description: Walk an app end to end and publish what you actually saw — web, iOS, Android, desktop or CLI. Drives the real app, captures every state, and writes a catalog, per-feature walkthroughs, persona journeys, verified fixes and an append-only run log into a Walkthrough Studio hub. Use when the user says /walkthrough, or wants to document, record, screenshot, demo or QA their app, generate onboarding guides, walk a user journey, verify a bug fix holds, or open a PR showing what a change does for the user.
